عَيْنٌ سَجُومٌ [An eye shedding many tears]. (S, TA.) ―
-b2- And سَحَابٌ سَجُومٌ (assumed tropical:) [Clouds pouring forth much rain; like سَجَّامٌ]. (TA.) ―
-b3- And نَاقَةٌ سَجُومٌ (tropical:) A she-camel yielding much milk: (A, TA:) or that parts her hind legs on being milked, and raises her head: (K, TA: [in the CK, سَعَطَتْ is erroneously put for سَطَعَتْ:]) as also ↓ مِسْجَامٌ . (K.) ―
-b4- رَجُلٌ سَجُومٌ عَنِ المَكَارِمِ (tropical:) A man who shrinks from generous actions. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
